title: Make projection repair proportional on stores with many task-sync delta exchanges, instead of re-validating the whole membership per delta four times
outcome: Make projection repair proportional on stores with many task-sync delta exchanges, instead of re-validating the whole membership per delta four times
acceptance: Projection repair on a store with D delta exchange events and M synced task documents no longer clones and validates the whole membership tree once per delta; a counter-based test shows tree validations bounded by bindings, not by D
closure::source::expected is computed once per repair and reused by closure::graph::expected and the post-write verification, rather than recomputed four times
Repair of a store with many delta exchanges completes within a bound the test states, with derived rows identical to today's
